subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the vines above a switch that raises the water level.

evidence.quote: Now, use the Fairy Slingshot to kill the Gold Skulltula on the vines, then raise the water level by hitting the switch to collect the token. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 030 out of 100)

subject: Boomerang
text: A large chest containing the Boomerang appears after defeating all the Stingers in the room.

evidence.quote: Inside are more of those Stingers. Once you kill them all, a large chest containing the BOOMERANG appears.

subject: Dungeon Map
text: Defeating the large tentacle by striking its narrow part with the Boomerang reveals a large chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Get close to it and keep moving while hitting the narrow part with the Boomerang (Z-targeting is excellent here) until it's dead. A large chest will appear. Open it to get the DUNGEON MAP for this dungeon.

subject: Compass
text: Popping all the Shaboms within 40 seconds makes a large chest appear containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: Head inside with Ruto and you'll be in a room filled with Shaboms. You have to pop them all in 40 seconds. If successful, a large chest will appear. Opening this will get you the COMPASS for this dungeon.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Two Gold Skulltulas are found along the wall in the large room where Ruto was first encountered.

evidence.quote: Look along the wall and you'll see two, yes two, Gold Skulltulas. Kill them and retrieve their tokens with the Boomerang. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 32 out of 100)

subject: Bigocto
text: Bigocto can be stunned with the Boomerang while circling to its backside to attack the green spot behind it.

evidence.quote: Instead of using my impossible "Boomerang it then hurry to its back", just Boomerang it as you're heading to its behind (Z-Target is your friend here) and you will have an easier time attacking the green spot behind it.

subject: Recovery Heart
text: One of the pots behind Link contains a fairy.

evidence.quote: (There's some pots behind you. One of them has a fairy.)

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on some vines in the room with Biri before the boss room.

evidence.quote: In this next room, kill all the Biri, then find a Gold Skulltula on some vines. Use the Boomerang to kill it and retrieve the token. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 33 out of 100)

subject: Switch
text: Standing to the left of the glass wall and throwing a curved Boomerang hits the switch that unlocks the boss room door.

evidence.quote: Head to the left of the glass wall, Z-Target it, and throw the Boomerang. If you got it right, it should just clear the wall and curve to hit the switch. Enter the door it just opened to enter the boss's room.

subject: Barinade
text: Barinade requires cutting loose its 3 tentacles with the Boomerang, stunning its center, destroying the protective jellyfish, and then stunning and slashing its exposed core.

evidence.quote: Z-target one of its tentacles and use the Boomerang to cut it loose. Do this for all 3 tentacles, and the jellyfish surrounding it will spin around. Boomerang its center to make it loose its grip on the jellyfish...Stun its center with the Boomerang, then move in and slash it.

subject: Barinade
text: Barinade can be killed more quickly by stunning it and using the shield stab attack after removing its protective jellyfish.

evidence.quote: SPEEDY STRATEGY: After getting rid of all its protective jellyfish, stun it and
simply use the shield stab attack to kill it more quickly.

subject: Heart Container
text: Defeating Barinade awards a Heart Container, bringing the total health to 9 hearts.

evidence.quote: When it's dead, collect the Heart Container, (9 hearts now!) and head over to the light where Princess Ruto is floating.

subject: Zora's Sapphire
text: Princess Ruto gives Link the Zora's Sapphire, the Spiritual Stone of Water, after exiting Jabu-Jabu's Belly.

evidence.quote: After exiting, say you want the Spiritual Stone and she'll give it to you. This Zora's Sapphire, is the last of the Spiritual Stones.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At night, a Gold Skulltula is found on the wall across from the log sticking out of the water in Zora's Fountain.

evidence.quote: First, make sure it's night here in Zora's Fountain, then head on top of the log sticking out of the water. You should find a Gold Skulltula on the wall across from the log. Remember to use the Boomerang for far away Gold Skulltulas. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 34 out of 100)

subject: Zora's River
text: Diving down to the bottom of the pool of water outside Zora's Domain connects through an underwater entrance to the Lost Woods.

evidence.quote: Once you exit, see the pool of water to the left? Head to it and dive down to the bottom, going through the entrance here. This is a warp over to Lost Woods.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Inside the Great Deku Tree, bombing a wall behind a Deku Baba past the upper crawlspace reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: On the other side, find the bombable wall behind a Deku Baba, bomb it, and you'll find a Gold Skulltula behind it. Kill it and use the Boomerang to retrieve the token. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 35 out of 100)

subject: Magic Bean
text: A Magic Bean can be planted in the soft dirt plot by the shop in Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote: Plant a Magic Bean on the plot of dirt by the Shop, then head back to Lost Woods.

subject: Magic Bean
text: A Magic Bean can be planted in the soft dirt plot found by heading left from the Lost Woods entrance.

evidence.quote: Once you enter, head left until you find another plot of dirt. Plant a Magic Bean here.

subject: Magic Bean
text: A Magic Bean can be planted in the plot of dirt behind the Business Scrub in the Lost Woods.

evidence.quote: Now, head back to the Lost Woods entrance, then head right, left, right, left, then left again and plant a Magic Bean on this plot of dirt behind the Business Scrub.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Planting a bomb near the tree by the castle walls opens a Secret Cave containing a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Head to Kakariko Village, but before you enter, notice the tree near the castle walls. Plant a bomb there to make a Secret Cave appear. Drop down, kill the Skulltula, and kill the Gold Skulltula here with the Boomerang. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 36 out of 100)

subject: Giant's Wallet
text: The Skulltula House gives the Giant's Wallet, which increases rupee carrying capacity to 500 Rupees, after collecting enough tokens.

evidence.quote: Head inside the Skulltula House and get the next prize, the Giant's Wallet, which can carry 500 Rupees.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is perched high up on the south wall at the far end of the Graveyard.

evidence.quote: Next, head to the Graveyard. Head to the far end and look on the south wall. There's another Gold Skulltula here. It's high up, so you know what item you need. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 37 out of 100)

subject: Magic Bean
text: A Magic Bean can be planted in the soft dirt plot located in the Graveyard.

evidence.quote: Before exiting, plant a Magic Bean on the plot of dirt here.

subject: Magic Bean
text: A Magic Bean can be planted in the plot of dirt located near the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern.

evidence.quote: Next head to Death Mountain Trail and deposit a Magic Bean on the plot of dirt near the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Climbing up the left side of the raised staircase room on the second floor leads to an alcove with a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Get to the second floor using the high-rise platform. From there, head over to the staircase room. Once you are there, you'll notice the staircase is back up. Climb up the left side and you'll reach an alcove with a Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 38 out of 100)

subject: Ocarina of Time
text: After Zelda throws the Ocarina of Time into the moat during her escape, retrieving it triggers a scene where Zelda teaches Link the Song of Time.

evidence.quote: After the scene is over, get into the moat and you'll see the Ocarina of Time Zelda threw. After grabbing it, a scene will show Zelda telepathically teaching Link the Song of Time to open up the Temple of Time.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At night, a Gold Skulltula is found up high on the left building of Lon Lon Ranch.

evidence.quote: Once in the ranch, (make sure it's night) look up at the left building. There's a Gold Skulltula up high. Use the Boomerang. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 39 out of 100)

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the wall to the right of the silo at Lon Lon Ranch.

evidence.quote: Now head toward the silo. The wall to the right has another Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 40 out of 100)

subject: Running Man
text: The Running Man running around Lon Lon Ranch will buy the Bunny Hood for as much money as Link can carry.

evidence.quote: Remember the Bunny Hood? This guy wants it, and he'll pay as much money to you as you can carry to get it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Bombing the center of the stone circle outside Gerudo Valley reveals a Secret Cave with a Gold Skulltula behind cobwebs.

evidence.quote: Before entering, plant a bomb in the middle of the circle of stones near the entrance. Drop inside after opening this Secret Cave. Now use Din's Fire to burn all the cobwebs off, and head into the corridor with a cow. There's another Gold Skulltula here. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 41 out of 100)

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At night, a Gold Skulltula is found on the wall to the right of the wooden plank in Gerudo Valley.

evidence.quote: Exit the cave, and enter Gerudo Valley during the night...For now, head forward to the wooden plank. To the right, on the wall, is another Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 42 out of 100)

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Gliding down to the ledge to the left of the bridge with a Cucco and breaking the crate reveals a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Now grab the Cucco, and drop down to the left of the bridge. You see the ledge with the crate? Float down there and break it to reveal a Piece of Heart. (HEART PIECES: 16 out of 36)

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Dropping bugs into the plot of dirt on the lower ledge in Gerudo Valley causes a Gold Skulltula to appear.

evidence.quote: Now drop some bugs onto the plot of dirt (grabbing another if possible) and another Gold Skulltula will pop out. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 43 out of 100)

subject: Magic Bean
text: A Magic Bean can be planted in the soft dirt plot on the lower ledge of Gerudo Valley.

evidence.quote: Plant a Magic Bean on the same plot of dirt.
